A young lion, emblem of strength, that boosts your prowess in Trials.
A watchful owl from the Chamber of Reflection that deepens your Reflection training.
A tiny kraken, tamed from chaos, that lends a tentacle at the agapes. Improves your Banqueting.
A rough ashlar that came to life and still dreams of being cubic. Enhances your Quarrying.
An ancient spirit of the cedars of Lebanon that aids your timberwork.
A cheeky gull from the Joppa Quay that boosts your provisioning expertise.
A living ear of wheat that whispers the word of plenty. Enhances your Cultivation.
A tiny ember of fanaticism, tamed by patience and good humour. Enhances your Wisdom.
A fragment of the Sovereign of Darkness\'s essence, bound to those who bested its master. Amplifies Trial experience.
A nimble sprite born from thousands of ritual circuits walked in silence. Guides your steps with uncanny grace.
A gentle pelican, emblem of charity, born from a thousand alms politely requested. Even tight purses open for it.
Drawn to the Lights of the Lodge for so long it became one. Its wings shimmer with residual heat.
A spirit born from the vapour of a thousand alchemical elixirs. Its presence sharpens the mind.
A crystallised fragment of meaning that slipped off a tracing board.
A tiny creature sculpted from gem shards and polishing dust. Keeps your jeweller\'s tools sharp.
A miniature dragon made entirely of quill feathers. Surprisingly eloquent.
A mischievous imp that lives inside Hiram\'s furnace. Its heat-hardened hide is impervious to burns.
A dragon hatchling raised on a diet of gold coins. It has an uncanny nose for profit.
A spirit awakened from sawdust and chalk lines. It knows exactly where every stone should go.
A mischievous imp from the Solstice Fair that juggles your worries away. Boosts all skill XP by 3%.
An ancient stone golem that guards the secrets of Jacob\'s Ladder. Boosts Trial XP.
A tiny ember spirit from the Summer St John\'s Feast that boosts your prowess in Trials.
A grinning gourd-light that escaped the Hollow King\'s crown and now lights your way through the Trials.
A stubborn little acacia sprig that took root on a fresh grave mound. It knows a thing or two about growing.
A regal goose that roosts atop the gilded Temple of Solomon. Coins simply seem to find its keeper.
A shimmering water spirit born from the surf of the Shores of Joppa. Never seems to fully dry.
A young forest creature with symbol-patterned fur, found among the ancient cedars.
A fire-born lizard that thrives in the cracks of the Peak of Fury. Its skin is always faintly warm.
A cold silver light that drifted up from the Abyssal Depths and refused to sink back into darkness.
A tiny turtle whose shell bears the same symbols as the Isle of the East\'s seal. Older than it looks.
A bird of banked embers that circles the volcano and roosts on your shoulder between Trials.
A miniature cousin of the Sea Serpent, coiled around your wrist like a living bracelet.
The Last Elder\'s faithful companion, bound now to whoever overcame its master. Its eyes still remember.

Your Rite grants Rite-locked Elevation upgrades. Changing Rite refunds any points spent in other Rites\' branches, and you can only change Rite once every 24 hours.
A quarry pick passed down through generations of masons. It remembers every stone its bearers ever freed.
A carpenter\'s axe worn smooth by a hundred hands. Every squared cedar sharpens it a little more.
Old scales that have weighed provisions beyond counting. They learn the market with every weighing.
A humble hoe that has turned soil for generations. Each harvest leaves it keener than before.
A founder\'s gavel black with the soot of a thousand forges. It grows truer with every strike.
A well-worn taper that has never failed to kindle the Lights. Every flame it lights burns a little brighter.
A ceremonial cane that has led circuits beyond counting. It grows surer with every ritual.
A seasoned pan handed down through generations of agape cooks. Every meal deepens its seasoning.
An old alms box that has gathered countless gifts for the Widow\'s Fund. It grows more persuasive with every round.
A sliver of the Guardian of the Vault\'s living gold. It drinks in a little of every Trial its wearer survives.
An ancestral chisel that wakes a little more with every Trial its line survives.
A colossal gavel of forgotten make. Each blow it lands adds to its legend.
A quill trimmed and re-trimmed across generations of orators. Every oration teaches it something.
A staff steeped in the symbols of every sage who ever bore it. Its wisdom still deepens.
